title: All About Slugs
note: b417 — Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — non-fiction, real facts about slugs.

pages.brief: A small grey-brown garden slug resting on top of a green leaf, close-up view.
A close-up of the slug showing its soft, bare body with no shell on its back.
The slug glistening with a thin layer of wet slime along its body.
A shiny, wet trail left behind on the leaf where the slug has moved.
The slug stretching slowly forward along a stem, one small movement at a time.
The slug nibbling at the edge of a soft green leaf.
The slug tucked under a damp stone in dappled shade, hidden from the bright sun.
Moss the hedgehog peering down at the slug among tall blades of long grass.
Moss the hedgehog looking closely at the shiny trail left on a leaf near the slug.
Moss the hedgehog smiling, with the slug resting on a leaf beside him.
